title: Equity Market Fragmentation and Capital Investment Efficiency
authors: Wayne R. Landsman; Jing Pan; Stephen R. Stubben
eligible_reason: Main analysis regresses investment on Tobin's q interacted with a continuous fragmentation measure (1 - HHI of trading venues) with firm and year FE and controls. The identification table (Table 8, Identification.do) uses a common post-Reg NMS indicator interacted with q (single date), an entropy-balanced DiD with a continuous r_at interaction, and 2SLS with the number of trading venues. No binary staggered treatment.
design_notes: Stata (areg/reghdfe). Compustat/CRSP/TAQ firm-year panel; analysis datasets shipped as .dta.
data_files_note: Readme.docx lists WRDS sources (CRSP, Compustat, TAQ, 13F, I/B/E/S, Mergent, DealScan) and maps tables to the shipped analysis files.
screener_notes: Screened from Readme.docx and do-files (no article text). Continuous treatment and common-date identification; not staggered.
